name: alpkit-store.github.io
description: A GitHub Pages site hosting internal tool documentation (e.g. Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon, and order management tools).
summary: This tool automatically collects and publishes documentation for Alpkit's internal software tools by gathering README files from selected repositories. It creates easy-to-understand summaries and organizes them into categories, making it simple for non-technical staff to find and understand information about tools like Shopify and order management. The tool helps keep documentation up-to-date and accessible without manual effort.
